ov: في خط النار (الإنجليزية: In the Line of Fire) ، هو فيلم أمريكي من نوع جريمة وتحقيق ، تم إنتاجه عام 1993م ونشره شركة "Colombia Pictures" ، وتتحدث القصة عن حادثة بعد اغتيال الرئيس الأمريكي جون كينيدي بمدينة دالاس بولاية تكساس الأمريكية عام 1963م.
plotEn:
Secret Service agent Frank Horrigan learns that a mysterious man calling himself "Booth" is planning to assassinate the President of the United States. Booth phones Horrigan to taunt him. Horrigan was one of President Kennedy's bodyguards on the day of his assassination. Obsessed with his failure to protect JFK, Horrigan has become a cynical, loveless alcoholic. His partner is the playful-but-businesslike Lily Raines.
Booth calls Horrigan several more times from public telephones, knowing the calls are traced, but he always escapes before the Secret Service can arrest him. Booth eludes Horrigan but inadvertently leaves a palm print on a passing car at one site. The FBI matches the print, but because the person's identity is classified, they notify 
the CIA and not the Secret Service. 
Horrigan nevertheless learns Booth is Mitch Leary, a former CIA operative who suffered a mental breakdown and is now a predator seeking revenge on his former supervisors. Leary, independently wealthy and tech-savvy, has molded a zip gun out of composite material to evade metal detectors, and can carry two bullets past a metal detector concealed in a key-ring ornament. He smuggles this weapon into a fundraising event where the President is scheduled to speak.
